model: JOHB-SMP3 BACnet/IP option (HV600, Z1000U, GA800 drives)
equipment_type: Variable frequency drive BACnet IP option card
applies_to: Yaskawa HV600, FP605, Z1000U, GA500, GA700 and GA800 drives and HV600/FP605 bypasses fitted with the JOHB-SMP3 card.
summary: The JOHB-SMP3 is a plug-in card that puts Yaskawa HVAC and general-purpose drives on BACnet IP. Each object maps to a drive Modbus register, so the same list covers several drive families; bypass-only and gateway-mode objects simply do not appear on a plain drive. AV29/AV30 give generic read/write access to any drive register.
firmware: Option firmware 3.x (application VST9070xx); GA500/GA700/GA800/FP605 bypass need option software PRG 7001 or later
notes: Device instance is built from drive parameters F6-49 and F6-48; the default object name is 'Yaskawa VFD ID' plus those values in hex.
IP settings come from F7-01 to F7-13 (or DHCP); the UDP port is set by F7-50.
Object names in the drive may use the shorter network display name shown in each description.
Points marked 'bypass only' exist only when the card is in an HV600 or FP605 bypass.
AV43-AV65 are gateway-mode objects for up to four downstream drives and only appear in gateway mode.
AV4 must not be combined with BO1-BO3 or BV12; AV5 must not be combined with AV1, BO4 or BV9-BV11.

source.title: YASKAWA AC Drive Option BACnet/IP Technical Manual, Model JOHB-SMP3

integration.summary: Set b1-01 = 3 (Option PCB) so the BMS sets frequency and b1-02 = 3 or 9 so it starts and stops the drive. Write BV1 Run FWD Cmd (BV58 on a bypass) and AV2 Frequency Cmd, read BV13/BV16 and AV10/AV12/AV13, and reset with BV4. Set the device instance in F6-48/F6-49 and the IP settings in F7-xx, and decide on the F7-57 bus timeout.
integration.enable: b1-01 Frequency Reference Selection 1 = 3 (Option PCB) and b1-02 Run Command Selection 1 = 3 (Option PCB) or 9 (AUTO Command + Option Run); both default to 1. On a bypass use BV58/BV59 instead of BV1/BV2. BV5 Drive Com Net Command and BV6 Drive Com Control Command (COM/LOCAL) are also provided. In HAND or LOCAL mode the drive ignores the network and disables the bus timeout.
integration.heartbeat: F7-57 BACnet/IP bUS Timeout Value: when above 0 the BMS must keep sending AV2 Frequency Cmd or a run command (AV1, BV1, BV2, BV58, BV59, AV43-AV51). If none arrives within that time while the drive is running, it trips on bUS Option Communication Error, handled per F6-01 (0 ramp, 1 coast (default), 2 fast stop, 3 alarm only, 4 alarm and run at d1-04, 5 alarm and ramp stop). F7-57 = 0 disables it. Switching to AUTO/REMOTE with no recent command gives an immediate bUS. With F6-14 = 1 and F6-01 set to 0-2, the option resets the fault and returns control to BACnet when comms recover.
integration.remote_sensors: AV3 PI Setpoint Cmd lets the BMS write the PI setpoint; BO4 Ref Sel: PI Setpoint (or AV5 bit 1) selects it as the setpoint input.
setup: Device instance = F6-49 (high word) and F6-48 (low word), in hex; e.g. instance 1234 is F6-48 = 4D2, F6-49 = 0.
F7-13 picks static or DHCP addressing (default DHCP); static IP, mask and gateway are F7-01 to F7-12 (defaults 192.168.1.20 / 255.255.255.0 / 192.168.1.1).
F7-50 sets the BACnet UDP port (default 47808); F7-51 to F7-56 set BBMD foreign registration.
F6-xx/F7-xx changes need a power cycle, or F6-15 = 1 Reload Now on non-Z1000U drives.
DIP switch S1 must read 75 in monitor U4-75 (switches 1 and 3 on) for BACnet/IP to work.
U6-80 to U6-83 show the IP address actually in use.
gotchas: Bits written to AV1 and BV7-BV11 are ORed with the hard-wired digital inputs.
Do not combine AV4 with BO1-BO3/BV12, or AV5 with AV1, BO4 or BV9-BV11.
F6-01 = 3 or 4 keeps the drive running after a bus fault; provide separate safety stops.
With RSTP ring networks, set F7-57 long enough for the ring to converge.
Frequency units for AV2, AV9 and AV10 follow drive parameter o1-03.
Bypass-only and gateway-mode objects are missing on a plain drive.
